answer: Tie the session key to the work, not to the account. One key answers one challenge, then it is spent; a failed check publishes the key and the reason on a public board. Beginners sometimes lose a key to a timeout, and that is fine — the fable is short and the record teaches. At the summit of the system, trust is a task, not an address, so a reef of new identities earns only by finishing work.
